claims.quote: An American credit card," replied Dr. Leete, "is just as good in Europe as American gold used to be, and on precisely the same condition, namely, that it be exchanged into the currency of the country you are traveling in.
claims.description: A national credit card will be accepted abroad and exchanged for the local national credit card on international accounts.

claims.quote: In national staples; a basis of agreement as to what staples shall be accepted, and in what proportions, for settlement of accounts, being a preliminary to trade relations.
claims.description: Trade balances between nations will be settled in agreed commodities instead of money.

claims.quote: a continuous waterproof covering had been let down so as to inclose the sidewalk and turn it into a well lighted and perfectly dry corridor
claims.description: Streets will be covered by retractable waterproof awnings that keep the sidewalks dry and lit.

claims.quote: and in the twentieth century they put up one umbrella over all the heads.
claims.description: Cities will shelter the whole public under shared coverings instead of individual umbrellas.

claims.quote: It is bound to print all that is offered it, but prints it only on condition that the author defray the first cost out of his credit.
claims.description: Books will be published by the nation, with authors paying production costs from their own credit balance.

claims.quote: The waiters are young men in the unclassified grade of the industrial army who are assignable to all sorts of miscellaneous occupations not requiring special skill.
claims.description: Citizens will serve compulsory terms in a national industrial army, assigned to occupations such as waiting on tables.

claims.quote: The highest of all honors in the nation, higher than the presidency, which calls merely for good sense and devotion to duty, is the red ribbon awarded by the vote of the people to the great authors, artists, engineers, physicians, and inventors of the generation.
claims.description: The highest national honor will be a ribbon awarded by popular vote to the leading authors, artists, engineers, physicians and inventors.

claims.quote: The subscribers to the paper now elect somebody as editor, who, if he accepts the office, is discharged from other service during his incumbency.
claims.description: Newspapers will be run by subscribers who elect and dismiss their editor, with the nation handling publication.

claims.quote: Not only is our cooking done at the public kitchens, as I told you last night, but the service and quality of the meals are much more satisfactory if taken at the dining-house.
claims.description: Household meals will be cooked in public kitchens and eaten in large public dining-houses instead of at home.

claims.quote: In the Parliament of man, the federation of the world.
claims.description: The nations of the world will be federated into a single parliament that ends war.

claims.quote: I should say that to me it seems to consist in the dignity you have given to labor by refusing to set a price upon it and abolishing the market-place forever.
claims.description: Labor will no longer be bought and sold for a price, and the market-place for services will be abolished.
